svg.title: Anatomy of an AI pick, from the sample response in the docs. Greek Yogurt Plain, confidence 92 out of 100. Why: customers buying milk frequently add Greek yogurt for a protein rich breakfast, and reviews highlight the creamy texture. When: for weekday breakfasts. Best for: health conscious families. Pros: high in protein, creamy texture, good value for money. Cons: slightly tangy taste, shorter shelf life than expected. Confidence colors: 90 to 100 green for high, 70 to 89 yellow for medium, below 70 red for low. Seeded review sentiment across 147 reviews: 112 positive, 21 neutral, 14 negative. Trust features: an expandable reasoning card, a confidence indicator, a review sentiment summary, a recommendation type badge with 7 types such as Frequently Bought Together and Meal Companion, an AI insights panel showing what was analysed, an informative empty state, and thumbs up or down feedback stored in localStorage.
